limitations: A selected cardiac reference subset. Cardiac/chamber region surfaces are not separately segmented histological wall layers or a clinically certified solid heart/cavity model.
LAD and pulmonary vein meshes with conflicting source labels/ontology are excluded. This is not a complete coronary tree.
Source diagonal branch remains selectable but default hidden because its LAD parent is excluded; no unsupported parent connection is added.
Left-circumflex posterior branches retain their source origin; they are not renamed as the right-coronary posterior interventricular branch.
Valves are static aggregate surfaces. Papillary structures are incomplete and some have only 76 or 82 triangles; no chordae or cardiac conduction system is added.
Same united source coordinates give coherent reference placement, not proof of one patient provenance or watertight vascular connections. No registration to another dataset.
